sections.Description:
The adventure takes players to familiar X-Men locations including the Danger Room, Beast’s Lab, the X-Mansion, and Genosha.

The Uncanny X-Men playfield is a unique pinball layout that features an array of new crossing shots and ramp designs with surprising ball trajectories to deliver kinetic satisfaction. The all-new Danger Room design, located to the left of the main flippers, offers a high-risk, high-reward experience that includes a mini-flipper and a novel outlane spinner.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Battle the Sentinel: A mechanically articulated Sentinel for the player to battle. The Sentinel’s large robotic head changes its state based on the player’s actions.
- Danger Room: The all-new Danger Room design, located to the left of the main flippers, offers a high-risk, high-reward experience that includes a mini-flipper and a novel outlane spinner.
- Sentinal Hand Ramps: Be careful because the Sentinel will fight back by destroying the player’s ramps or attacking the ball with its extended hands.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- The world of the X-Men is brought to life with an extensive cast of iconic characters, devices and location.
- Experience an innovative new playfield layout from designer Jack Danger that features several new crossing shots and ramps designs.
- Players can extend the fun with Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ system by discovering mutants with Cerebro and using their mutant powers in online Quests!

Premium:
- Every player who logs in with Insider Connect will be granted a mutant power to aid them with their online missions.
- Custom X-Men soundtrack featuring multiple time periods and musical styles from Charlie Benante of Anthrax and Pantera fame.
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.

Limited Edition:
- Exclusive "Sentinel Armor" powder-coated pinball armor, legs, hinges and Action Button front molding.
- Limited Edition "Danger Room" inspired full color mirrored backglass with hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting with X-Men themed effects.Upgraded speaker system with 3-channel amplifier.
